meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas (live data, not an archived version; give corpus_snapshot and source_commit). doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: A bivalent molecule engages an FKBP12-dependent site and the active site simultaneously, producing deeper mTORC1 inhibition than a rapalog while sparing mTORC2.
data.mechanism_beginner: A two-part drug grips mTORC1 at two places at once, which blocks it more completely than rapamycin-type drugs. So far only a first safety trial in people with advanced tumours has reported on it.
data.boundary: Phase 1 in advanced solid tumours – a safety and pharmacodynamic result, not an efficacy verdict. Directness is graded indirect because, like rapalogs, the mechanism requires FKBP12. Consensus is emerging: one trial.

confidence.human_relevance_label: plausible in people, not shown directly
